description: Declared platform matrix for the self-contained sap-adt runtime. 'status' is maintained explicitly: 'verified-local' and 'verified-ci' require a real native build + install smoke on that OS/arch, locally or in CI respectively. Never mark a target verified from a script's existence alone.

windows-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.4 Windows x64 runtime built with Windows Python 3.12 via WSL interop on 2026-11-21; ZIP and isolated npm install passed diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes, including execute-only snippets with generic source writes disabled. Windows-local npm regressions: 42 passed, 5 platform-specific skips. The 1.6.4 desktop installer was built with official portable Inno Setup 6.7.4 and passed native PATH cleanup tests, silent per-user install in a Unicode/space path, same-version upgrade and uninstall; synthetic configuration and user/machine PATH were preserved. Interactive wizard, actual PATH mutation, elevated installation, live Windows SAP access and live debugger attachment are unverified.

linux-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.4 verified on Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 (WSL2), 2026-11-21: 518 Python and 47 npm tests, clean wheel install and native npm diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes, including execute-only snippets with generic source writes disabled. DEV verified local object creation, Class source parts, candidate checks, activation/Unit, RAP source/unpublished-binding evidence and technical OData V2 preview; all 36 attempted development probes independently verified absent. Published RAP/V4 runtime and non-local package/TR creation were not live-verified. glibc floor applies to other distros; do not generalize to musl/older glibc without a real build there. Live debugger attachment is unverified.

darwin-aarch64.notes: Experimental CLI 1.6.4 macOS 15+ Apple Silicon runtime, verified 2026-11-21. Native macos-15 CI with Python 3.14 passed 518 Python tests (3 skips), 46 npm tests (1 skip), runtime build and isolated npm diagnostic/debugger/execution cross-process smokes: Actions run 44904521434, source f2a61e3e99f8f8de2ddaa1e7b4a7af27fba49004. Execution smokes keep generic source writes disabled. No personal Mac, older macOS, live SAP, Keychain, Gatekeeper/quarantine, signing or notarization verification.
